params.name: includeDraft
params.description: Whether to include draft walls in the results.  Defaults to false.

params.name: next
params.description:
An opaque cursor used to request the next page of results.
It is provided in the previous response from the api.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return.  max: 30

items.docs:
Get a paginated list of stock walls.  (i.e., well-known wall
types).

Subsequent pages can be requested with the "next" parameter, which is
returned in the response metadata object if another page exists.

Creates a new stock wall.  Can only be called by kumospace
admins.
